title: Club Membership: employer-funded share of a medical-hold dues waiver
content:
## Scope
This document states, for a Club Membership medical-hold dues waiver, the basis on which an employer-linked benefit funds part of the outstanding balance being waived.

## Rule
Where the member is also the customer of an active corporate wellness enrollment, that linked employer partnership tier's own discount percentage, combined additively with that same partnership tier's own multi-location discount percentage, is treated as the employer-funded share of the outstanding balance. That combined percentage is applied once, as a single combined percentage, to the outstanding balance available to waive; it is never applied as two separate percentages taken one after the other.

## Condition table
| Member's corporate wellness enrollment | Employer-funded share |
|---|---|
| Linked and active | That partnership tier's own discount percentage, combined additively with that same tier's own multi-location discount percentage, applied once to the outstanding balance |
| Linked but not active | None |
| No linked enrollment | None |

## Points of judgement
Where the member carries no active corporate wellness enrollment at all, the entire outstanding balance available to waive is a matter for the club's own waiver alone, with no employer-funded share reducing it.
